okf_specification.domain: Quantitative Algorithmic Crypto Trading & Prediction Markets
okf_specification.description: Canonical Open Knowledge Format guidelines synthesizing multi-model trading strategies, self-learning agent memory loops, TradingView webhook architectures, and regulatory compliance rules.

rules.turnover_tds_impact: 1% TDS is levied on total transaction volume. High-frequency scalping erodes small accounts; bot MUST enforce low-turnover swing or high-conviction momentum strategies.

regulatory_and_tax_compliance.disclaimer: Tax and regulatory values are OKF reference assumptions only — not personalized tax advice. Review against current applicable law before any production use. Production trading remains disabled in this repository.

prediction_sizing.formula: f_star = (p * b - q) / b; position_size = 0.25 * f_star

hard_circuit_breakers.action_on_breach: Flatten all open positions and halt bot execution loop

correlation_filter.rule: Block new long entries on risk-on assets (e.g., BTC/USD) if correlated index assets (e.g., SPY & QQQ) are both currently in long positions.

post_mortem_analysis.action: Classify loss cause and save setup parameters into references/failure_log.json

pre_trade_memory_check.action: Query vector database/failure log for identical technical setups before submitting live order. Abort if past failure match confidence > 80%.

brier_score_recalibration.action: If BS > 0.25, lower prediction model confidence weightings and shrivel Kelly multiplier to 0.25x.

trading_models_and_strategies.name: Power of Three (PO3) Liquidity Sweep
trading_models_and_strategies.rules: Detect sweeps of PDH/PDL/PMH/PML followed by candle body close rejection, confirmed by ADX > 21 and volume > 1.3x.

trading_models_and_strategies.name: VWAP Reclaim with Displacement
trading_models_and_strategies.rules: Reclaim of VWAP with displacement candle body (> 0.3 ATR) aligned with 4H higher-timeframe trend bias.

trading_models_and_strategies.name: ICT 4H/15m Fair Value Gap Swing Setup
trading_models_and_strategies.rules: 4H swing high/low sweep -> 15m Market Structure Break (MSB) -> 15m FVG formation -> Retrace to >= 0.5 Fib level -> Limit Order entry in FVG.

trading_models_and_strategies.name: Multi-LLM Ensemble Prediction Bot
trading_models_and_strategies.entry_condition: Execute limit order when (p_model - p_market) > 0.04 and VADER NLP sentiment score >= 0.

trading_models_and_strategies.name: Donchian Channel Breakout
trading_models_and_strategies.rules: Go long on 20-period High break with 1.5x average volume confirmation; trail stop with 2x ATR.

infrastructure_and_webhook.server_environment: Linux VPS (DigitalOcean / AWS) with HTTPS SSL Certificate
